title: Chapter 263
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

It was ten minutes past the agreed time, but the power plant still hadn't exploded. The bandits were anxious.

"Have the people who blew up the power plant been caught? We haven't heard from them for so long." The crooked mouth man made a few phone calls, but they were all busy. No one answered.

His accomplices were obviously thinking of retreating.

"We've been exposed. Let's go quickly. If the people who blew up the power plant are caught, they will expose us …"

The crooked mouth man's eyes were fierce. He shouted in a low voice, "What are you panicking for? Wealth comes from danger. How can we come here for nothing?"

This was obviously a group of low-level bandits, but at the same time, they were extremely daring.

After waiting for a while, they finally found an opportunity. The patrolling guards crossed each other, and there was only one guard left at the gate.

The crooked mouth man pointed at one of his men, "You, go and assassinate that guard!"

The man who was pointed at stepped out unwillingly. He tiptoed and carefully approached the patrolling guard. His hand was holding the handle of the dagger behind his waist. He was trembling nervously, and the tip of his nose was sweating.

Although the enemy only had one patrolling guard, he was still equipped with a gun.

The guard turned his head and saw a figure sneakily approaching within twenty meters. He immediately shouted, "Who's there?"

Luo A was scared. He quickly stood up straight and said in a panic, "I … I'm just passing by!"

After that, he ran back with a face full of fear. He said with a sad face, "Boss, I've been discovered."

"Useless!" The crooked mouth man said angrily. He took out a crude handgun from his waist and handed it to another man. He shouted, "You go! This handgun has a limited range of twenty-five meters. Kill the guard for me! "

Luo B swallowed his saliva and walked over with the gun in his hand.

When he was about twenty meters away, the guard found a figure again.

"Who's there?!"

Luo B was scared, "I … I'm out for a walk!"

The guard saw the outline of the gun in Luo B's hand. He said vigilantly, "What are you holding in your hand?"

"This, this …"

Luo B was quick-witted. He raised his head and put the gun near his eyes. He said in a panic, "This is a telescope. I, I use it to admire the moon."

Then, he also ran back like a puff of smoke.

On the other side, Mad Blade and the other three were puzzled. What were these people doing back and forth?

The crooked mouth man was flustered and exasperated. "Trash! All of them were trash! Give me the gun, I'll do it myself! "

Grabbing the gun, the crooked mouth man quickly walked towards the guard. The guard was already vigilant, so he immediately asked, but just as the first word came out of his mouth, the crooked mouth man brazenly opened fire. The gunshot was loud, and the bullet hit the guard's shoulder. The guard cried out in pain and fell to the ground. The crooked mouth man added two more shots, and this time the guard was seriously injured and lost the ability to fight.

"Hurry up and move the things." The crooked mouth man called out, and all of his underlings followed. At this time, in the vision of Mad Blade and the other three, the bandits had turned red. The mission was to capture the bandits alive and hand them over to the shelter guards.

If they were enemies, it would be easy to deal with them. Players were best at fighting monsters.

Hao Tian took the lead, and Mad Blade followed closely behind. The four of them rushed out. The bandits were shocked and hurriedly took out their weapons to block. However, in just one exchange, half of them were knocked over by the four of them.

"Inhumans, they're all Inhumans!"

The four of them knocked over all the bandits like they were cutting vegetables, and only the crooked mouth man was left. He held the gun and shivered. "Don't come any closer, or I'll shoot … I'm really going to shoot!"

Suddenly, the ground trembled slightly, and more than a dozen red dots lit up in the darkness. They quickly approached and showed their true appearance. Six Generation 25 Rangers surrounded the scene, and their black muzzles were locked onto everyone.

In important places like warehouses and power plants, the Rangers created by Han Xiao were the real defense force. They were always on standby. Once they detected gunshots or someone broke through the security zone without permission, they would immediately go from standby to combat mode and attack like awakened beasts.

Sanctuary Three was Han Xiao's territory, and it was heavily guarded. It was not a place that any Tom, Dick, or Harry could mess around!

The change was too sudden, and everyone was shocked.

Mad Blade and the others recognized that the Rangers were created by Han Xiao. Pork Bun quickly said, "Don't open fire, we're on the same side …"

However, once the Rangers were activated, the order was to kill everyone in the security zone. Plus, the chip of the Rangers did not have the ability to process voice commands.

The next second, bullets rained down, and the bandits and Mad Blade's group of four were all shot. The bandits were all turned into sieves.
